title: AI Guard on one key
lede: AI Guard is an inspection policy attached to the agent key, with per-detector alert, sanitize and block thresholds and an optional external service.

edges.label: settings apply to this key's calls

steps.title: Configure on the key
steps.what: AI Guard is set in the Runtime Protection step of the Agent Registry wizard: an Enable switch and a Fail Closed switch (off means fail open).
steps.why: The policy attaches to the credential, not the network; a team can watch a new policy before enforcing it.

steps.title: Detectors and thresholds
steps.what: Eleven built-in detectors each carry alert, sanitize and block thresholds on a 0 to 1 score, plus an optional External Guardrail service.
steps.why: Threshold values seen in testing came from one key and are not product defaults.

steps.title: The strongest threshold reached acts
steps.what: Alert records a finding without blocking, sanitize rewrites, block stops: the strongest threshold reached sets the action.
steps.why: Tool-call arguments are not inspected by this control.
